causal_question: In 255 identical development states immediately before a scripted opponent first changed styles, the round-four adaptive generalist scored 183 points, its permanently primed population component 192, its table component 169 and plain W-tap 29.5. Does a shorter or longer commitment to the current expert improve the weakest historical matchup?
intervention: Keep both expert weight sets, every observation and every learned selector coefficient fixed. Cross minimum dwell durations 1,2,4,6,9,14,20 input heads with gate hysteresis multipliers 0.5,1,1.5,2,3,6. Add continuing each pure component, the unchanged generalist, Hold-W and W-tap. Train/screen on all 16 original training donors. Select six distinct challenger definitions by the already declared individual mean, worst-five and single-worst objective. Compare these on the eight exposed development donors, including all four adaptive rounds as opponents. Preserve every actual title winner.
evaluation: The fixed title selection and sealed probe schedule keep their original entrants. Play a separate matched native and simulator stress test against previously reserved within-fight switching pairs. Show W-tap, the unmodified generalist, both pure components, and the cadence contender only when its development merit exceeds the original generalist. Use two repeats at both seats and both symmetric RTTs. Disclose early ring-outs before a planned change. Report changes in actual selected controls and all individual results.
